name: BL∞ Canonical Logic Stack — Open-Ended Dynamic Public Projection

projection.name: BL-RP / Reality Proposition
projection.description: Reality is distinguished from every model, description and finite observed slice. Actuality authority and generative precedence are separate axes.

projection.name: BL-GTP / GiaTai Proposition
projection.description: GiaTai is an assumed, represented or derived reality-state whose actuality is not yet established. GiaTai may lead generation without self-declaring actuality.

projection.name: Unknown as first-class epistemic object
projection.description: Known Unknown, Opaque Unknown, Unrepresentable-yet, Unknown-Unknown Indicator and Unknown Decidability are preserved distinctly; Unknown is not treated as falsehood.

projection.name: Mixed / contested / underdetermined phase regions
projection.description: Truth-GiaTai entanglement is decomposed across claims, evidence, context, time and representation instead of being forced into one permanent third truth value.

projection.name: BL-OEPS open-ended phase space
projection.description: Objects are located in a multidimensional epistemic phase vector whose current dimensions are versioned and non-exhaustive.

projection.name: BL∞ dynamic possibility field
projection.description: BL∞ has no permanent above/below relation to Reality, GiaTai or Unknown. It expands representations, possibilities, reachability and consequences under context-dependent precedence.

projection.name: THUC_DINH / Reality-Determined mode
projection.description: Reality -> BL∞ -> GiaTai -> test interface -> Reality. Reality leads the local generative cycle.

projection.name: GIA_DINH / Hypothesis-Determined mode
projection.description: GiaTai -> BL∞ -> consequence/test interface -> Reality -> revised GiaTai. GiaTai leads the local generative frame without acquiring actuality authority.

projection.name: Unknown/anomaly discovery route
projection.description: Unknown or structured residual -> raw preservation -> BL-UUH missing-structure signatures -> BL-DGE candidate dimensions -> BL-OME ontology mutation -> BL∞/hypothesis/testing.

projection.name: Epistemic standing / scholarly entry
projection.description: BLEE separates broad standing to submit inspectable objects from unequal evidential weight; Academic Democracy provides the public scholarly interface.

projection.name: BL-HRD GiaTai/hypothesis processing
projection.description: GiaTai, reality gaps and candidate structures become hypothesis objects with provenance, depth/risk, expected value, preservation and verification portfolios.

projection.name: Identity / provenance / living research objects
projection.description: BL-ADN, BL-LOG, BL-CHRONO, BL-PCRO, BL-OODP and BLOK preserve raw state, identity, version, dependency, critique and history without equating preservation with endorsement.

projection.name: Novelty / adversarial pressure
projection.description: BL-NOVO disciplines novelty claims; BL-REV and BL-AEGIS search for premise, scope, measurement, ontology and representation failures before expensive external verification.

projection.name: Reality-facing and formal adjudication
projection.description: RVT/RVP/RVTP/RVL update model state from qualified evidence where empirical actuality is at stake; formal proof or other fit-for-object methods apply where appropriate.

projection.name: Future regression / resource routing / agency
projection.description: BL-SFRET maps necessary conditions and gaps; OPT-HKRP routes a minimal sufficient distributed coalition; OHAS defines authorized bounded execution, decision rights, safety and rollback.

projection.name: Knowledge-to-capability conversion
projection.description: KAT governs knowledge rights/disclosure and conversion of sufficiently supported useful knowledge into capability without permitting adverse-evidence suppression.

projection.name: Open-ended frontier return
projection.description: New capability may reveal Reality, generate GiaTai, expose Unknown/anomaly, or show representation failure. The return path is multi-polar, not a single fixed node.

projection.name: BL-DGE / BL-UUH / BL-OME ontology evolution
projection.description: Structured residuals can trigger dimension genesis or ontology mutation; candidate dimensions must earn retention and may be pruned, merged or made dormant.

projection.name: BL-CDE Civilizational Discovery Ecology
projection.description: Science, mathematics, engineering, philosophy, simulation, lived/citizen observation, art/metaphor, AI and anomalies may generate candidates; none receives truth-status merely from origin.

projection.name: Publication / critique / revision spiral
projection.description: BL-PIRAL and social-response mechanisms publish, index, collect critique, audit, patch, version and republish; reaction is feedback, not a truth vote.

projection.name: Cross-cutting constitutions
projection.description: BL-ADN/LOG/CHRONO preserve identity and causal memory; BL-CPR limits public disclosure; Reality-facing correction constrains claim status while discovery taxonomy remains open-ended.

parallel_loops.hypothesis_determined_loop: GiaTai -> BL∞ -> Consequences/Test -> Reality -> revised GiaTai
parallel_loops.unknown_discovery_loop: Unknown/Anomaly -> BL-UUH -> BL-DGE/BL-OME -> new representation/dimension -> BL∞ -> test or GiaTai
parallel_loops.capability_loop: Knowledge -> Resources -> Agency -> Action -> Capability -> BL∞ -> Reality, GiaTai or Unknown mode

progress_rule: A recursive pass counts as progress only when it produces an auditable evidence, negative-knowledge, model, GiaTai, unknown-structure, dimension, ontology, representation, scope, measurement, capability, resource, decision, outcome, provenance or risk delta.
guardrail: This artifact is a reduced public conceptual projection of the BL∞ open-ended dynamic discovery system. It exposes state-space openness, named public mechanisms, modes, invariants and feedback only; it does not disclose protected production implementation.
